title: Wire sync-cli-context-files.mjs as Stop hook + drift detector
brief: CLAUDE.md/GEMINI.md/AGENTS.md are kept in sync by helper but currently manual. Drift compounds across multi-CLI sessions. This MS wires the helper as a Stop hook + drift detector. 2 days of work, biggest insurance-per-day in V2.

units.title: Wire sync-cli-context-files.mjs as Stop hook
exit_conditions: Stop hook fires when CLAUDE.md changed in session
propagates to GEMINI.md + AGENTS.md within same Stop
test: edit CLAUDE.md -> Stop -> all 3 files identical
units.description: Existing helper at H:/PRISM/.claude/helpers/sync-cli-context-files.mjs. Add hook entry to settings.json (via /update-config skill, not direct edit).
units.shipped: 2026-06-18 slot:golf -- .claude/hooks/stop-sync-cli-context.mjs (drift-gated Stop hook + injectable detectDrift) wired into settings.json Stop array (C: + H:, valid JSON, 69 entries); 9/9 detectDrift tests (happy + failure + adversarial) + live-validated {continue:true} + sync path proven (6 mirrors updated on drift). Settings edited via the c-to-h mirror (canonical path; /update-config note is obsolete).

units.title: DriftDetectorEngine: alert on >24h divergence
exit_conditions: periodic check (cron or SessionStart) compares 6 mirror files
if any pair drifts (different mtime AND different content), warning emitted
test: corrupt 1 mirror -> detector flags it
units.description: Cheap insurance. Warning only, not blocking. NOTE: P0-U01's Stop hook auto-syncs on SOURCE drift, so source-newer divergence self-heals; P0-U02 remains valuable for MIRROR corruption (a mirror manually edited / content-diverged WITHOUT a source change -- the Stop hook's mtime gate does not catch that). Build as a SessionStart/cron content-compare detector, warning-only.
units.shipped: 2026-06-18 slot:golf -- .claude/hooks/sessionstart-cli-context-drift-warn.mjs (SessionStart warning-only detector) reuses the exported MIRRORS/stripExistingHeader/CODEX_ADDENDA from sync-cli-context-files.mjs (refactored: main-guarded + exports) to content-compare each mirror vs its source-derived body; flags MIRROR corruption the P0-U01 mtime gate misses. Wired into the user-global settings.json SessionStart array (C:+H:, valid JSON, 63 entries). 10/10 findDivergedMirrors tests + live-validated (corrupted GEMINI.md -> flagged 2 diverged incl a real pre-existing AGENTS.md drift -> sync restored -> clean). Knob: PRISM_CLI_CONTEXT_DRIFT_WARN_DISABLE=1.

acceptance: CLAUDE.md edit auto-propagates to GEMINI.md + AGENTS.md within same session; drift detector reports diff if files diverge >24h.

risks.description: Stop hook latency adds to session-end UX; mitigation = run async, no-block on Stop
